append: node scripts/update-economics-rail.mjs (after-close push) appends each new date and corrects a recent date only when its source value changed (for example a final futures close). It never rewrites points outside the fetched window, does not rebuild weekly/monthly/yearly, and does not edit essay pages. Those tabs are views of points. Oil points are the Yahoo bar. Do not splice the after-close tape over them.
